# Google Nest Mini and Home Mini

Play audio and control playback or volume on Google Nest Mini or Home Mini through Muse Home Link, using the shared Google Cast skill when the receiver is available; the individual speaker is distinguished from an existing group. Both models are audio-only, and the whole Cast procedure lives in the companion gadget-google-cast skill, referenced from this profile as ../gadget-google-cast/SKILL.md.
